model: unsigned composite Port–Euler observer; exactly one inactive Port 01; 14 active pair Ports, 4 forced color supports and 16 flexible triple supports
statement: For every n in strictly positive integers to the 20 triple-color supports, there exists a connected exact-multiplicity event multigraph with all fourteen active pair Ports positive even degree, hence an Euler circuit from any active Port
certificate_row_index: forced-color parity mask in order 012,013,014,015, least significant bit first
certificate_decoder: For each flexible triple, index its three pair Port vertices in lex order, then its three allowed edges in combinations order; a ternary digit selects the edge

verification.arithmetic: Python standard-library exact integers; deterministic static certificate verification, no random inputs
verification.proof_extension: Any flexible support selected edge uv and count n>=2 can be replaced by connected legal triangle edge multiset with XOR boundary uv and exact count n; singleton retains selected edge; all forced edges remain present

limitations: Only the unsigned auxiliary observer model
No proven typed signed P000 TRIADIC_CLOSURE_E event-lift
No proven ordered BRC provenance preservation
Marked 44->42 constructions not universal arbitrary-source compression
